name: Constructable
description: Break ground on a new way to manage construction. Constructable for Claude turns project data into a conversation — ask what's open, what's overdue, or what happened in the field yesterday, and get a straight answer in seconds. Connect your Constructable account to pull project status, RFIs, submittals, and daily reports straight from chat, no digging required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Constructable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Constructable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.constructable.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Constructable MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Constructable provides these MCP tools: execute_constructable_script, list_organizations, mutate_graphql, query_graphql, and search_constructable_schema.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Constructable?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Constructable in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Constructable requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Constructable is developed by Constructable. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
